wcagRationale: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.2 applies when audio plays automatically on a page for more than 3 seconds. The packet provides positive evidence claims that audible audio autoplayed for more than three seconds and that no independent pause, stop, mute, or volume control was available. On that evidence, the target likely fails Audio Control.
missingEvidence: Underlying raw observation details for the timed playback measurement are not included.
Specific DOM or UI evidence showing absence of all independent pause, stop, mute, or volume controls is not included.
Browser autoplay policy/capture context is not independently documented beyond the packet's validatorObserved=true claim.
falsePositiveRisks: The fixture/validator claim could be wrong or scoped too narrowly if an independent audio control exists outside the captured target or visual reference.
Browser autoplay behavior may differ by environment, user settings, permissions, prior interaction, or muted autoplay handling.
A control might be present but visually hidden, delayed, keyboard-only, or otherwise outside the evidence excerpt.
